In this computer lab for linear algebra, you're going to apply the eigenrating technique to a league of four teams each pair of which plays once.

```{ojs}
function toMarkdownTable(games) {
  if (!games.length) return "";

  // Get headers from the keys of the first object
  const headers = Object.keys(games[0]);

  // Build the header row and the separator row
  const headerRow = `    | ${headers.join(" | ")} |`;
  const separatorRow = `    | ${headers.map(() => "---").join(" | ")} |`;

  // Build the data rows
  const dataRows = games.map(
    game => `    | ${headers.map(h => game[h]).join(" | ")} |`
  );

  // Join everything together
  return [headerRow, separatorRow, ...dataRows].join("\n");
}
```
